melting_point.range_text: The melting point, determined as the onset of the melting peak, typically lies in the range from about 118° C. to 124° C.

analytics.conditions: differential scanning calorimetry, aluminum closed cup, heating rate 10 K/min
analytics.raw_text: Thermogram of form A: characteristic melting peak in the range from 110 to 135 deg C; the melting point taken as the onset of the melting peak typically lies from about 118 to 124 deg C, in particular from 119 to 122 deg C. Lines 161-162.

notes: Crystalline form A of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form A. Thermal data only; the section names no other substance. melting_point carries the onset range the patent itself calls the melting point, 118 to 124 deg C, rather than the 110 to 135 deg C peak range, which is recorded in the DSC analytics entry. The alias is capitalised as 'Form A' because that is how this section prints it; the lowercase 'form A' does not occur in these two lines. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything.
